name: Terminal Executor
description: Execute terminal and PowerShell commands with configurable permissions, output capture, and safety policies.
author: SORA Core

defaultShell.description: Default shell environment for command execution

requireConfirmation.description: Require explicit user confirmation for potentially destructive operations

openInWindow.description: Run commands in a visible Command Prompt window on the desktop instead of running silently in the background

tools.name: terminal_execute
tools.description: Execute a shell or PowerShell command with output capture, exit code reporting, and execution status.

cwd.description: Working directory (defaults to current active workspace root)

openInWindow.description: Open a visible Command Prompt window on the desktop to execute the command visibly instead of running internally

tools.name: terminal_open
tools.description: Open a visible Command Prompt (cmd.exe), Windows Terminal (wt.exe), or PowerShell window on the user's desktop, optionally navigated to a directory and/or executing a command in the opened window.

command.description: Optional command to execute inside the opened terminal window (e.g. 'node -v', 'dir', 'npm start')

cwd.description: Directory to navigate the opened terminal to (defaults to current active workspace root)

keepOpen.description: Keep terminal window open after running command so user can see output (default: true)
